list_channels: list all top-level gRPC channels using the ChannelzServiceClient list_channels method
list_servers: list all gRPC servers in the process using the ChannelzServiceClient list_servers method
find_server_listening_on_port: find a gRPC server listening on a specific port using find_server_listening_on_port
list_server_sockets: list all sockets for a given gRPC server using the list_server_sockets method
sock_address_to_str: convert a gRPC channelz socket address to a human-readable string using sock_address_to_str
